d:
Did you know U.S. Soldiers can earn official foreign military awards through ruck marches? In this video, I cover four of the most recognized military rucking events that can earn authorized foreign badges or medals for wear on the Army Service Uniform (with proper approval).
We'll take a look at:
Norwegian Foot March
International Four Days Marches Nijmegen
Marche Internationale de Diekirch
Danish Flyvermarch
